paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Solar neutrino (SNO) energy-loss limit on axion-photon coupling: g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1, valid for sub-keV axion masses (m_a < ~0.2 eV for helioscope-relevant range). Mass-independent bound encoded as horizontal line using sentinel mass 0. Paper also derives Yukawa boson-electron couplings (AxionElectron: PS g_ee < 2.8e-11, S 2.4e-13, V 1.7e-13 for keV-mass bosons, mass-dependent in Fig.1), but the primary reported result highlighted in abstract is the axion-photon coupling. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
